Pri (CS): Heads-up: Mosaic QBR Mon 11am PT. Need: token runway slide, 2 commit scenarios, onboarding blocker summary, and a one-line renewal ask by EOD Fri. Can @Alex - FinOps own the econ?

Alex - FinOps: I got it. Preference: show last 30d daily spikes + 90d trend, plus per-route top 5. I'll prepare 2 commit sims (conservative +10%, aggressive +30%) and a quantization delta.

alerts-bot: ALERT: mosaic-prod crossed 72% of monthly commit yesterday. Link: https://billing.redwood.example/mosaic-prod/usage

Riley (SE): Onboarding: ingestion resumed but we saw a 1hr retry storm during a bulk backfill that inflated token counts. Root cause = producer duplicates + missing dedupe keys. Hotfix validated in staging; prod deploy pending their infra window Mon 2pm PT.

Tomas (CSM): Customer asks to include: 1) per-route token visibility, 2) request for a short burst credit, 3) whether quantized model keeps exact JSON fields. They also want a simple ask line for renewal.

Alex - FinOps: Draft numbers (pre-verify): last30d tokens = 38.2M; projected month = ~42.1M. If unthrottled projected overage = ~4.1M tokens (~$900). Scenario sims: A) +10% commit -> modest invoice increase but fewer throttles; B) +30% commit + q2-small-quant -> higher commit but ~17% unit cost reduction, net similar spend with lower variance. Latency delta for q2-small-quant: +5-9ms median.

Riley (SE): I tested q2-small-quant on their templates: schemas preserved for most routes; one strict parser failed on whitespace/float formatting. Recommend templating review before recommending quant in the QBR.

Tomas (CSM): I'll draft the renewal ask: "Increase monthly commit to 55M for 12 months; Redwood to provide a 30-day burst cushion and quarterly cost reviews." Will grab a short customer quote to include.

Pri (CS): Owners recap: Alex (econ + charts + alerts), Riley (integration notes + templating risk), Tomas (customer quote + sales handoff), Pri (deck + runbook). Please push charts and CSV to /drive/mosaic-qbr before EOD Fri. Reconvene Fri 4pm PT for final pass. :thumbsup:
